description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in Uganda. Run 24/7 cloud computers, web automation, coding, and Telegram teams from Kampala across East Africa.
h1: Run Autonomous AI Agents Across Uganda
sub: Equip your business with tireless AI bots that browse, code, and coordinate tasks on dedicated 24/7 cloud computers, even when your phone is switched off.
audience: Agribusiness exporters, freight and clearing forwarders, Kampala tech startups, wholesale merchants, and professional service firms across East Africa.
manifesto: Ugandan commerce moves fast, from Kikuubo trading alleys to regional export corridors. Ceyo gives you tireless cloud agents that research markets, write code, and coordinate workflows around the clock, keeping your business running even when local connections drop.

uses.d: Monitor global auction prices for robusta coffee, tea, and vanilla, compiling market intelligence into Google Sheets automatically.
Track freight documentation, monitor clearing updates along the Northern Corridor, and notify your logistics team via Telegram.
Deploy cloud-based coding agents that develop web apps, test APIs, and push code directly from your mobile phone.
Autonomous web agents research international competitor packages, draft custom travel itineraries, and log inbound inquiries into your CRM.
Scrape regional distributor catalogs, extract bulk purchase tariffs, and build comparative price matrices without manual entry.
Browse government gazettes and procurement portals daily, extracting deadline dates and required paperwork into organized summaries.

steps.d: Select your plan and launch dedicated, isolated cloud computers for your bots in seconds.
Connect your bots to Telegram, Gmail, Notion, and over 1,000 tools to build your custom team.
Schedule web research, code execution, and routine updates that run continuously in the cloud.

chapters.d: While you commute through Kampala traffic, your Telegram bot delivers a summary of overnight freight confirmations and global commodity pricing. Your team of specialist agents has already filtered urgent client requests into your inbox.

Your autonomous browser agent logs into customs portals, verifies shipping clearance updates, and flags delayed transit documents. The data is parsed instantly into your shared spreadsheet without opening your laptop.

Your technical agent writes and verifies backend scripts inside its isolated cloud machine, building a responsive client portal. It submits a review summary and live test link directly to your group chat.
You power down your phone for the night, but your cloud bots keep running without interruption. They crawl competitor rates, archive daily records, and prepare tomorrow's operational schedule.

faq.q: How does Ceyo keep working when my phone is off or power is out?
faq.a: Every Ceyo agent runs on its own isolated cloud computer hosted in high-availability data centers. Tasks, scheduled routines, and browser automations run continuously 24/7 regardless of your local device status or internet connection.

faq.q: What are the pricing tiers and how does the free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription plans: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a payment card is required at signup and is only charged when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Can I manage my Ceyo agents directly inside Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with your bots individually or add multiple specialist bots into Telegram group chats. They will collaborate as a coordinated team, sharing long-term memory and project documents.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents research local and international websites?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo includes an autonomous web browser that navigates websites, compares prices across regional portals, fills forms, and extracts unstructured data into clean reports or spreadsheets.

faq.q: Which languages and business tools does Ceyo support?
faq.a: Ceyo operates natively in English, translates regional languages, and connects seamlessly with over 1,000 applications including Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, Notion, and modern CRM systems.
